primary_test_workflow.description: Primary CI workflow with full test suite
test_steps_with_database_url: Run Phase 3 - Event Sourcing Truth Verification
primary_test_workflow.notes: Uses in-memory PostgreSQL service container. DATABASE_URL is hardcoded for test database. Safe for CI. Not using GitHub secrets for test database credentials (intentional for local testing).

ci_cd_foundations_workflow.description: Phase 13 Slice 1 verification workflow (build + type + prisma verify only)
ci_cd_foundations_workflow.notes: This workflow intentionally skips database connectivity for faster CI feedback. BUILD and PRISMA VALIDATE run without DATABASE_URL. This is acceptable because Next.js build can work without DATABASE_URL if SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true. Tests are run separately in ci.yml with DATABASE_URL.

summary.database_url_ci_security_notes: Using hardcoded test database credentials in CI workflow is intentional and safe. PostgreSQL service container runs only during CI job execution and is isolated to the GitHub Actions runner. No secrets or production credentials exposed.

deployment_impact: Code can be deployed with confidence that all database-dependent tests have been run in CI with a live PostgreSQL service container.
notes: DATABASE_URL is properly wired in the primary CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml). A PostgreSQL 16 service container is spun up for each test run with health checks. All database-dependent steps (prisma validate, prisma migrate deploy, build, tests) receive the DATABASE_URL environment variable. This ensures migrations are tested and the database schema is verified before merge. The ci-cd-foundations.yml workflow intentionally does NOT include DATABASE_URL to provide faster feedback on code quality gates (governance, typecheck, build). This is a good practice for multi-stage CI pipelines.
